answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Network caps new identities at 1 percent of established count per epoch, no exceptions. A ferrous of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the echo of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and inlet-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
